content.text:
I reviewed the whole agreement for assignment and change-of-control language and submitted one finding.

**Findings:** Section 15 (p0080) is the sole assignment provision; no change-of-control trigger appears anywhere in the document. As drafted it is a mutual bar on assignment without prior written approval, with a no-consent exception only for a "financially responsible affiliate."

**Classification: deviation (fails fallback).** There is no successor/M&A carve-out for either party, no written-notice mechanic for successor assignments, and the approval standard is unqualified rather than "not unreasonably withheld."

**Target level: preferred.** Curing to fallback would have required deleting our existing no-consent affiliate right, weakening Client; the preferred position preserves and extends it.

**Redline (validated ok:true, minimality passed):**
1. Replace the mutual restriction so only TrueLink needs Client's prior written approval, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and never to a competitor of Client.
2. Insert a short Client-side sentence permitting assignment without approval to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and confirming a Client change of control gives TrueLink no termination right.

All six preferred elements are mapped exactly once; unrelated text (heading, Sections 13/14/16) is untouched.
